QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Yuris's Communication Device
QuestInfo.0: Yuris at Altaire Camp is calling for you. What is it this time?
QuestInfo.1: You have to go ask #b#eEllin at #m300030100##n#k what color she wants the communication device to be. She's not going to like this...
QuestInfo.2: You went to go see Ellin at #m300030100#. Ellin did not care about your question, and instead had something to tell you.

0.0: Hello! Enjoying the weather? I'm not! This humidity wreaks havoc on my machines! I hate it!
0.1: I have a favor to ask of you, which I just KNOW you will do. After all, we are FRIENDS, aren't we?

yes.0: So I made this communication device. I know how it looks, but it's pretty handy! Anyway, I wanted to give this to my good friend Ellin. That way, whenever I'm craving more fruit, I can contact her directly! Since this is a special gift, I want to make sure it's the right color. Could you ask Ellin what color she wants it to be?

no.0: Wait, but... no... you were supposed to say 'sure, no problem.'

1.0: What is it now? Did you come to help protect the forest?

yes.0: I thought I TOLD you, I'm not so buddy-buddy with Yuris! And who cares about the color of some stupid mechanical junk! I have more important things to worry about.

npc.0: Please go ask Ellin what color she prefers. She's in the Deep Fairy Forest.
